publicDeploymentAuthorisation.ownerWords: Pass stage 16 - direct instruction - no arguments, then do stage 17 Ignore the blocked agents. Playing tour and auction matches should be user playable.
publicDeploymentAuthorisation.scope: A GitHub Release (alpha-2026-11-19) of the public repository, with the game and source zips built from the tagged commit.

capabilities.advertised: Deterministic T20, ODI, and five-day red-ball match engines with hash-chained replay
Pre-game world editing and JSON roster pack import across exhibition and T20 career play
Cross-format T20/ODI/red-ball tactical AI profiles, reversible delegation, and deterministic red-ball weather/forecast interruptions
Completed career match event archives, replay without recomputing outcomes, and checkpoint inspection and recovery, in portable career archives
Fixed-seed cross-format replay (100 matches per format) and release-scale synthetic diagnostics, with synthetic claims only
Precached offline shell, transaction-deferred safe updates, retained engine assets (/engineering.html recovery), keyboard/contrast/150%/200%-zoom accessibility
Persistent multi-season 8-club T20 career: player lifecycle and youth academy, contracts and budgets, tactical briefings, durable managed-match recovery
Live 2D field and highlights, contextual text commentary, optional procedural sound and narration
Historical statistics and leaderboards, match and season awards, player and manager stories
Opt-in exhibition rules: ICC-style super overs, rain-shortened T20 and one-day matches with a fictional resource table, and player reviews (DRS)

Captain's highlights: limited-overs exhibitions, managed T20 fixtures and two close-finish scenarios played in bounded passages with plans; rival captains with observable tendencies and an opt-in match-aware opponent; a match-day selection room in career; the Pavilion redesign of club selection, career home and the scoreboard

Fictional tournaments: built-in and user-made competitions, tours against a touring XI, squads rebuilt by auction, and built-in team crests; the player can play their own team's matches, including tour and auction matches

knownLimits: Model calibration status is SYNTHETIC_ALPHA (synthetic-alpha-01): all teams, players and results are fictional, and no claim of realism or ICC certification is made.

Stage 16 was passed by the owner's direct instruction on 18 November 2026. None of its four parts (owner-PC measurements including the 768 MiB memory budget, observed playtest, screen-reader walkthrough, 20-season soak) were run, and the repository holds no results from them.
Test evidence comes from hosted CI (Linux, and Windows with Chromium and Firefox) and Linux containers only. Nothing has been run on Safari or macOS.
Rain-shortened matches and player reviews are exhibitions only and never enter career or tournament tables. Weather in careers applies to five-day red-ball matches only.
Tournament matches between generated squads (tours and auctions) have no super over: a tied knockout goes to the higher-placed side.
The Windows launcher EXE is unsigned (owner decision), so Windows SmartScreen may warn before it runs.
Saves live in the browser profile, tied to http://127.0.0.1:4180. Clearing browser data deletes them: export .lcxxvi backups. An older build cannot read saves written by this one.
The close-finish and captaincy features were checked by automated browser runs only: no human playtest responses or voluntary replays were collected (docs/verification-close-finish/PLAYTEST.md).
testedRevision is the commit the record was generated on, which is the commit before the record itself: a file cannot contain its own commit hash.
recoveryInstructions: Interrupted career fixture match: reopen #career, #roster-career, or #exhibition in the same browser profile; durable managed-binding:<matchGameId> records re-associate or settle completed results automatically.
Unwanted or stuck pending career match: open #exhibition and click "Abandon career match" to release the binding without corrupting the career save.

Damaged newest match or career checkpoint: open the affected save or click "Create recovered copy" to roll back deterministically to the newest valid hash-verified checkpoint in a fresh slot while preserving pending match bindings.
Cross-device backup or browser reset: export portable .lcxxvi archives from #exhibition, #career, or #roster-career and re-import them with full event-chain hash verification.
Staged offline update or asset trouble: updates wait until active match/save transactions finish; /engineering.html remains precached as an explicit diagnostic and recovery surface.
